_about: Every stand-in the engine's tests use, paired with the real system it stands in for and the check in lib/realcheck.cjs (chronos verify-real) that runs the same behaviour against that real system. test/realcheck.test.cjs fails if a stand-in is missing here, an entry names a stand-in that no longer exists, or a named check does not exist. Attack stand-ins (built to misbehave) are paired with the check proving the real system behaves.

MockERC20.real: USDC, WETH and the other Aave reserves on Arbitrum One

MockAP.real: Aave V3 PoolAddressesProvider (read through the pool)

MockOracle.real: Aave V3 price oracle (read through the addresses provider)

MockV3Factory.real: Uniswap / Sushi / Pancake V3 factories in venues.json

MockV3Pool.real: the real V3 pools those factories return

MockQuoter.real: the real QuoterV2 contracts in venues.json

MockV2Factory.real: Uniswap / Sushi / Pancake / Camelot V2 factories in venues.json

MockV2Router.real: the real V2 routers in venues.json

BrokenMulticall.real: Multicall3 (attack stand-in: the real one answers)

v2/MockLaxRouter.json.real: attack stand-in: the real routers pay what they report

v2/MockPoolManager.json.real: Uniswap V4 PoolManager 0x360E68faCcca8cA495c1B759Fd9EEe466db9FB32 on Arbitrum One

v2/MockCurvePool.json.real: Curve StableSwap-NG USDC/USDT0 pool 0x49b720F1Aab26260BEAec93A7BeB5BF2925b2A8F on Arbitrum One

v2/MockV3FactoryTS.json.real: Aero Slipstream CL factory 0x88a60ee77392577c355C0acb2A8d476D5a4EC03a on Arbitrum One (pools by tick spacing)

v2/MockAlgebraFactory.json.real: Camelot V3 (Algebra) factory 0x1a3c9B1d2F0529D97f2afC5136Cc23e58f1FD35B on Arbitrum One (one pool per pair)

server:engine-service.test.cjs.real: your alert webhook and phone notifications

fetch:agents.test.cjs.real: OpenRouter (your AI agent key and model)

portal:render_test.js.real: your Supabase project behind the portal (also portal/real_check.sql)

fetch:alerts.test.cjs.real: your project's alerts function (device-signed), your own webhook, and OpenRouter's model list

feed:providers.test.cjs.real: your websocket feeds and every https node you set, on the plans you are on (Infura, SwiftNodes, others)

fetch:vpaudit.test.cjs.real: arbitrum.blockscout.com (CHRONOS_BLOCKSCOUT_URL), answered in the shapes the live deployment returned

fetch:vpbrain.test.cjs.real: OpenRouter and Anthropic with your keys (every key in the rotation), the allowlisted documentation hosts and arbitrum.blockscout.com

fakeRealtime.real: Supabase Realtime of your project (topic chronos-pool-moves), fed by the ingest function

fetch:spend.test.cjs.real: OpenRouter chat completions (your AI key and model): each real call is counted against the daily cap

fakeChain.real: the key agent on your phone signing for your real contract on Arbitrum One (chronos executor status / verify-real)

fakeAgent.real: the key agent on your phone (lib/keyagent.cjs), probed by chronos verify-real: it must refuse non-trades and sign as your executor

server:blockfeed.test.cjs.real: your real websocket nodes (ARBITRUM_WSS_URL…) through the block feed

fakeRclone.real: rclone with your gdrive: remote on the phone (the key pull on update)

fakeFetch.real: api.1inch.dev and api.etherscan.io with your real keys

fetch:witness.test.cjs.real: arbitrum.blockscout.com and api.etherscan.io answering the witness check

fakeSpeech.real: your device's text-to-speech (termux-tts-speak on the phone)

fakeKeys.real: your keyboard in Termux (space, n, r, q) while chronos narrate runs; the voice it controls is checked by narrate-voice

fakeEtherscan.real: api.etherscan.io (V2) with your key on Arbitrum One and Base

fetch:liquidations.test.cjs.real: api.etherscan.io (V2) answering chronos liquidations on Arbitrum One and Base

fakeNode.real: your RPC nodes (ARB_RPC_URL…), each through the fast-fail client

server:fan.test.cjs.real: a rate-limited or hung real RPC node
